description: Renders a list of social media links as anchor elements. Each link includes an aria-label with the platform name for screen reader accessibility.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between social link items
Activates the focused link and navigates to the URL

focus.notes: Each link displays a visible focus ring. Links follow standard anchor focus behavior.

announcements: Each link announces its aria-label containing the platform name
When labels are shown, the visible text is used as the accessible name

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for link labels)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for icon buttons and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide valid URLs for each social link
When using icon-only mode (showLabels=false), ensure each link has an appropriate aria-label
